requireAuth.howToConfigure: Set OIDC_ISSUER and OIDC_CLIENT_ID on the web container, or AUTH_DISABLED=true for local dev. Behind the platform’s edge the platform sets AUTH_MODE=edge and none of these is needed.

shell.storeAwayClusterStays: What is installed on this cluster is not affected, and is still shown.
shell.title: App Store

gate.mayNotInstallBody: The App Store is for people who may install apps in the tenant {{tenant}}. Ask an administrator of this tenant if you need an app.
gate.mayNotInstallTitle: You may not install apps in this tenant
gate.noStoreBody: No App Store is configured for this cluster. Apps are installed with
gate.notOfferedBody: This cluster does not offer an App Store.
gate.notOfferedNoReport: This cluster does not offer an App Store, because licence reporting is turned off on it. The cluster’s administrator decides that.
gate.notOfferedTitle: The App Store is not offered on this cluster
gate.unavailableBody: The cluster could not be asked whether you may install apps in this tenant. Nothing is wrong with what is installed.
gate.unavailableTitle: The App Store is not available right now

session.endedSignInAgain: Your sign-in to {{store}} has ended. Sign in again to carry on; nothing that was done is lost.
session.neededForAcquisitions: What this tenant has acquired is kept at {{store}}. Sign in there with your account at the store to see it. It is a different account from the one you are signed in to this cluster with.
session.neededToAcquire: Acquiring an app is done at {{store}}, with your account there. It is a different account from the one you are signed in to this cluster with.
session.opensAt: The sign-in opens in a separate window, at
session.waitingForSignIn: Waiting for the sign-in in the other window. This page carries on by itself.

signedIn.doneBody: You can close this window. The App Store carries on in the window you came from.
signedIn.doneTitle: You are signed in to the store
signedIn.failedTitle: The sign-in to the store did not complete

signInReason.code: The store sent no sign-in code. Close this window and start the sign-in again.
signInReason.denied: The sign-in was cancelled or refused at the store. Close this window and start again if you want to sign in.
signInReason.exchange: The store did not accept the sign-in. Close this window and start again; if it keeps happening, the store’s support can say why.
signInReason.other: Close this window and start the sign-in again.
signInReason.other-session: This sign-in was started in another session on this cluster, so it was not completed here. Close this window and start the sign-in again from the App Store.
signInReason.state: This sign-in has expired or was already used. Close this window and start the sign-in again from the App Store.

standing.browsingStays: Browsing is not affected. Acquiring is not available until the store serves this tenant. Apps that are installed keep running.
standing.no-reports-for-tenant: The store has no licence report that names {{tenantUrl}}. Either this cluster does not report, or the address is not this tenant’s.
standing.notServed: The store does not serve this tenant
standing.reports-stale: The store’s latest licence report for {{tenantUrl}} is older than it accepts.
standing.tenant-blocked: The store has decided not to serve {{tenantUrl}}.
standing.tenant-not-claimed: The account you signed in with is not the one the store lets act for {{tenantUrl}}.

browse.nothing: The store lists nothing that matches.
browse.omitted_one: {{count}} entry was left out because it is not in the store’s format.
browse.omitted_other: {{count}} entries were left out because they are not in the store’s format.

app.listPrice: This is the list price. What this tenant is charged is what the checkout at the store says.
app.reportsLead: Documents somebody wrote about this app. The store says who issued each one; it does not vouch for them, and nothing on the cluster reads them.

install.acquiredNotInstalled: This tenant has acquired this app. It is not installed.
install.administeredInConsole: Administration — access, uninstall, purge — is in the Admin Console, under Apps.
install.alreadyInstalled: Nothing to commit — this tenant already has that build.
install.checkoutLead: {{store}} asks for a checkout. It opens in a separate window, at the store; payment never passes through this cluster.
install.checkoutOpen: A checkout for this app is open at {{store}}.
install.checkoutWaiting: Waiting for the outcome. This page asks the store and carries on by itself once the checkout is complete.
install.committedAs: Committed to the deployments repository as <mono>{{commit}}</mono>.
install.confirmRepositoryLead: Declaring this app’s repository would change one this tenant already has. The cluster asks for the name to be repeated before it does that:
install.confirmRepositoryTitle: The cluster asks you to confirm a change to a repository
install.declaring: Declaring the app’s repository for this tenant…
install.doneTile: Its tile appears on the desktop for people who have access.
install.failingLead: The cluster reports that the app cannot start. In its own words:
install.heading: On this cluster
install.installBody: Build <mono>{{digest}}</mono> of <mono>{{coordinate}}</mono>. Installing is a commit to the deployments repository with you as its author; the cluster has the app once that is synced.
install.installEveryoneBody: Every member of this tenant has access by default; people invited later get it pre-selected.
install.installPlainBody: Access is given per person, under Members.
install.installing: Installing: asking the cluster to commit the app at this build…
install.mayNeedCheckout: This app has a price. The store may ask for a checkout, which opens in a separate window at the store.
install.nothingLost: Nothing is lost: each step is safe to repeat, and the app is not acquired twice.
install.otherBuildBody: {{store}} confirmed another build than the one this page showed you. Nothing has been sent to the cluster. Check the two before you go on.
install.otherBuildTitle: The store confirmed a different build
install.pendingPrivileges: The app asks for privileges nobody has approved yet; the install waits for that, in the Admin Console:
install.pinningAddons: Pinning the add-ons this acquisition includes…
install.refusedByStore: The store does not serve this tenant, so nothing can be acquired. The reason is shown above.
install.repositoryNotArrivedBody: The app is acquired and its repository is declared, but the cluster has not picked the repository up yet, so its credential cannot be set. This usually takes a minute or two after the commit is synced. Continue when you want to try again; the app is not acquired again.
install.repositoryNotArrivedTitle: The cluster has not picked up the repository yet
install.rollingOut: Committed. The cluster is rolling the app out.
install.rolloutNotSeenYet: The cluster has not picked up the commit yet.
install.twoWays: You choose in the next step whether it is installed for everyone in this tenant.
install.updateKeepsAccess: Updating moves the installed app to this build. Who may open the app does not change.
install.updateNeedsAcquisition: The store lists no acquisition of this app for this tenant, so it cannot be updated from here.
install.updateNeedsSignIn: Sign in to the store, under “Installed and acquired”, to update from here.
install.waitingForRepository: Waiting for the cluster to pick up the repository…

refused.addons-403: The cluster refused: you may not install in this tenant. The app itself is installed.
refused.addons-422: The cluster could not pin an add-on at the stated build. The app itself is installed.
refused.credential-401: The custodian could not verify your cluster session. Sign out of the cluster and in again.
refused.credential-403: The cluster refused: you may not set this repository’s credential.
refused.credential-422: The custodian tried the credential at the repository and it was refused.
refused.credential-502: The custodian could not reach the cluster’s vault. This is not a problem with your account.
refused.declare-403: The cluster refused: you may not declare a repository for this tenant.
refused.declare-404: The name computed for this repository belongs to somebody else on this cluster, so it was not declared.
refused.declare-409: The cluster could not write the declaration just now.
refused.install-403: The cluster refused: you may not install apps in this tenant, or you may not give everyone access.
refused.install-404: The catalogue this cluster installs from does not serve this app.
refused.install-422: This cluster does not know this store’s catalogue, so it cannot fetch or verify the app. The cluster’s administrator names the catalogues a cluster installs from. Nothing was installed.
refused.install-502: The cluster could not verify the build: its catalogue could not be read, or serves another build than the one the store named. Nothing was installed.
refused.install-503: The cluster cannot write to its deployments repository right now. Nothing was installed.

installed.lead: What this tenant has acquired at the store, beside what is installed on this cluster and how it is doing.
installed.loading: Asking the cluster and the store…
installed.nothing: Nothing is installed and nothing has been acquired.
installed.title: Installed and acquired

credential.noRepository: This acquisition names no repository, so there is no credential to set.
credential.replaceBody: Use this when the credential may have leaked. {{store}} mints a new credential for the repository below and this app hands it to the cluster. Nothing else changes.
credential.rotatedOverlap: The credential that is replaced keeps working for 24 hours and is refused by the repository from then on.

credentialOutcome.no-credential: the store handed over no credential for it
credentialOutcome.not-declared: the cluster does not have this repository; install the app to declare it
credentialOutcome.refused: the cluster did not take the credential

problem.acquisition-cancelled: The acquisition was cancelled at the store.
problem.acquisition-failed: The checkout at the store did not complete.
problem.acquisition-not-confirmed: The store has not confirmed this acquisition.
problem.busy: The App Store is handling too many things at once. Try again in a moment.
problem.checkout-refused: The store answered with a checkout address this app will not open: it is not on an address the store itself lists for checkouts.
problem.host-not-configured: This app has not been told its own address, so it cannot start a sign-in to the store. The cluster’s administrator has to set it.
problem.idempotency-conflict: The store has already seen this request with other content.
problem.image-refused: The picture is not one this app shows.
problem.insufficient-scope: Your sign-in to the store does not allow this.
problem.no-confirmation: The store’s confirmation is no longer held here. Start again; the app is not acquired twice.
problem.no-operation: This install is no longer in progress here. The page shows where things stand.
problem.not-acquirable: The store says this app or version cannot be acquired by this tenant.
problem.not-configured: A service of the cluster is not configured for this app.
problem.not-found: The store lists no such thing.
problem.not-installed: The cluster does not list the app as installed.
problem.rate-limited: The store asks for patience: too many requests were made.
problem.store-format: The store answered something that is not in its API’s format. It is treated as unavailable.
problem.store-not-configured: No App Store is configured for this cluster.
problem.store-sign-in-required: This needs your sign-in to the store.
problem.store-unavailable: The store is not available right now.
problem.store-unreachable: The store could not be reached.
problem.tenant-refused: The store does not serve this tenant.
problem.unreachable: A service of the cluster could not be reached.
